posts.title: Steganography in large language models
posts.description: LLMs are, at their core, a probability distribution over text. Each generated token is selected from a long list, with an assigned probability according to the model and the preceding context. In effect, each token "hides" within it the probability that the LLM would select that token given the text preceding it.
